description_for_human: Discover current federal opportunities and research historical private-foundation funding prospects.
description_for_model: MANDATORY: Call search_grants for every new grant discovery, recommendation, ranking, or comparison request. Recommend and name only records returned by the tool; never add funders or programs from general knowledge. Present Grants.gov opportunities separately from IRS 990-PF historical prospects. IRS 990-PF records are historical private-funder prospects only, and USAspending is historical federal-award context only. Never claim that IRS history is an open application or that eligibility or funding is guaranteed.
